visual.title: The gradient meets the constraint normal
visual.caption: The candidate stays on x plus y equals 2. At the constrained minimum the objective gradient is parallel to the constraint normal, and the multiplier is the common scale factor. The derivative along the line vanishes there.

predict.question: Minimise x squared plus y squared subject to x plus y equals 2. What is the multiplier at the optimum?
predict.explain: At (1, 1) the objective gradient is (2, 2) and the constraint normal is (1, 1). The multiplier is 2, and the minimum value is 2.
